= Paragraph Hard Breaks
:hardbreaks-option:

.Header document attribute
Header first
Header second

:hardbreaks-option!:

.Default paragraph
Default first
Default second

.Repeated normal spaces
Repeated   normal   spaces

.Shorthand option
[%hardbreaks]
Shorthand first
Shorthand second

.Named options
[options=hardbreaks]
Options first
Options second

.Named opts
[opts=hardbreaks]
Opts first
Opts second

.Explicit break
Explicit first +
Explicit second

.Formatted content
[%hardbreaks]
Formatted *bold first
bold second* and _italic first
italic second_.

.Role does not enable hard breaks
[.hardbreaks]
Role first
Role second

.Style does not enable hard breaks
[hardbreaks]
Style first
Style second

.Empty middle line
Middle first +
 +
Middle third

.Leading empty line
{empty} +
Leading second

.Repeated empty lines
{empty} +
Repeated second +
{empty} +
Repeated fourth

.Literal paragraph
[literal]
Literal   paragraph first
Literal paragraph second

.Literal block
....
Literal   block first
Literal block second
....

.Listing paragraph
[listing]
Listing   paragraph first
Listing paragraph second

.Listing block
----
Listing   block first
Listing block second
----

.Source paragraph
[source,ruby]
puts "source   paragraph first"
puts "source paragraph second"

.Source block
[source,ruby]
----
puts "source   block first"
puts "source block second"
----

.Verse paragraph
[verse]
Verse   paragraph first
Verse paragraph second

.Verse block
[verse]
____
Verse   block first
Verse block second
____

:hardbreaks-option:

.Canonical document attribute
Canonical first
Canonical second

[quote]
____
Nested first
Nested second
____

* List first
List second

:hardbreaks-option!:

.Canonical attribute unset
Canonical unset first
Canonical unset second

:hardbreaks: false

.Alias with a value
Alias value first
Alias value second

:hardbreaks!:

.Compound option does not propagate
[quote%hardbreaks]
____
Compound first
Compound second
____
